economic_hypothesis: A multi-session trading suspension accumulates public and corporate information while the last tradable price remains frozen. The first reopening session is therefore an objective information-release auction and a new price-discovery event. Whether the repricing is subsequently accepted, rejected, or partially repaired may contain long-side information, but direction is deliberately not assumed in the mother family.

v26_methodology_transfer.objective_pre_existing_object: the last tradable corporate-action-coordinate close strictly before a genuine suspension episode
v26_methodology_transfer.information_discontinuity: at least five consecutive market sessions with trade_status not equal to one immediately before the reopening session
v26_methodology_transfer.interaction: the first hard-valid, tradable, non-ST reopening session and the later path around the frozen pre-suspension price
v26_methodology_transfer.why_distinct: The price discontinuity is caused by a trading and information hiatus, not a normal overnight true gap, an ordinary price-limit event, a generic bearish displacement candle, or a new listing.

mother_definition.reopening: current trade_status equals one and the immediately preceding row has trade_status not equal to one
mother_definition.minimum_suspension: none of the five immediately preceding exact market-calendar rows has trade_status equal to one
mother_definition.left_truncation_guard: the exact row 125 market sessions earlier exists, has cal_idx=current cal_idx-125, and shares the current invalid_step_cum
mother_definition.pre_suspension_reference: last prior row with trade_status equal to one and positive coord_close
mother_definition.coordinate_guard: the pre-suspension reference shares the current invalid_step_cum
mother_definition.signal_validity: hard_valid, current_valid, current_day_data_tradable, market_rule_valid, corporate_action_valid, not corporate_action_blocking, historical_identity_valid, non-ST, positive coordinate OHLC, and available_at no later than decision_at

frozen_chart_label.entry: first legal non-limit-up coordinate open in signal+1 through signal+3
frozen_chart_label.exit: first legal non-limit-down coordinate open at or after 20 held market sessions
frozen_chart_label.corporate_action_contract: QD-010 exact coordinate lineage; fail closed on any blocking or unresolved change

chart_protocol.review_order: all chronological sheets first, then complete profit/loss groups

prohibited: no reopening-gap direction chosen before full chart review
no outcome aggregation before all charts are rendered and reviewed
no generic price-limit or new-listing substitution
no 2022-2024 read before the development gate
